name: Trello
prompt: Build a responsive kanban board with projects, columns, draggable cards, labels, assignees, due dates, checklists, comments, filters, and activity history. Persist everything in SQLite, support keyboard navigation and JSON export, and make the UI feel instant with optimistic updates.
notes: The core product is cards moving between lists. For a small team, one sharp build can cover most of the value.
targetBuyer: Operations consultants and client service teams
